dataQualityPanel.title: Data quality contract
dataQualityPanel.dryRunHelp: Runs the contract against the live table and lands nothing.
dataQualityPanel.dryRunNoResponse: The dry run returned no response.
dataQualityPanel.datasetHelp: The table the checker observes, as '<data source>/<schema>/<table>'. It is resolved against the governed catalog, the same way the scan resolves it.
dataQualityPanel.argsHelp: Each row is one check. Edit its args in place — the checker's own contract text is serialized from these rows.
dataQualityPanel.invalidRow: This row's args did not parse; the previous value was kept.
